name: zclass_typelist_print_bucket
description: zClass_TypeList::PrintBucket prints each node name in a type-list bucket with a zero-based index.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this debug printer; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass list/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x44ecb0 validates loading the selected bucket head, walking links through next pointers, printing "Node %d desc: %s\n" with a zero-based index and node name, and returning after the final link.
The native smoke captures stdout and verifies the printed node order for a populated bucket.
